evidence: Sort by Priority shows order: Review project proposal (High), Complete tax filing (High), Submit final report (High), Schedule dentist appointment (Medium), Buy groceries (Low).

Sort by Deadline order: Buy groceries (Tomorrow/Aug26), Review project proposal (Aug27), Submit final report (Aug30), Schedule dentist appointment (Sep1), Complete tax filing (Sep8), Simple Task No Deadline (no deadline, listed last).
Created task "Simple Task No Deadline" with title only; active count increased from 5 to 6, task appears in active list.

Created "Full Detail Task" with description, deadline Sep 15, High priority, prerequisite "Buy groceries". Task card shows all details correctly and displays "Prerequisite \"Buy groceries\" incomplete".
Assigned "Buy groceries" as prerequisite to new task "Full Detail Task"; saved task displays blocked state with prerequisite warning referencing "Buy groceries".

issue: Edit action fully disabled for blocked tasks instead of allowing description/priority edits
actual: For blocked task "Submit final report" (prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete), the edit (pencil) icon button has the disabled attribute and clicking it does not open any edit dialog or inline editor. Clicking the task title also does nothing. There is no way to modify description or priority while the task is blocked — the entire edit capability is disabled, not just title/deadline.

evidence: Blocked task "Submit final report" is rendered with muted/dimmed styling (bg-muted/30) distinct from active cards, and its complete-toggle button carries the disabled attribute, preventing completion while prerequisite "Review project proposal" is incomplete.

Single incomplete prerequisite showed 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'; earlier with two incomplete prerequisites (Complete tax filing + Review project proposal) the same task showed '2 prerequisites incomplete'.
Hovering the "Prerequisite \"Review project proposal\" incomplete" warning shows a tooltip titled "Dependency Chain" listing "Review project proposal — pending".

issue: Dashed dependency connector lines are not interactive/hoverable
actual: The dashed connections are rendered two ways: (1) an SVG overlay (class "... pointer-events-none z-0") containing dashed paths between dependent/prerequisite cards, and (2) small "bg-dashed-line" divs between adjacent cards. The SVG paths are geometrically zero-width (straight vertical lines) and are visually obscured by the solid task-card divs stacked above them (Playwright reports "<div> subtree intercepts pointer events" when attempting to hover the connector at any point along its length), so a real pointer can never reach them except at the small gap segment. Hovering that exposed small dashed-line div (between "Review project proposal" and its dependent "Complete tax filing") produced no tooltip or popup at all — no dependency chain information was shown. Only hovering the textual prerequisite warning badge on the blocked task (tested separately under IX-20) shows the dependency chain popup; the visual dashed connector itself does not.

evidence: Edited "Buy groceries" -> title "Buy groceries (updated)", description updated, deadline changed to Aug 28, priority changed to Medium, added prerequisite "Schedule dentist appointment" — all changes persisted and displayed on the card. Created and then deleted "Throwaway Task For Deletion"; task removed from list and active count reverted from 6 to 5.

Clicked complete toggle on eligible active task "Review project proposal"; it left the Active list (5->4) and now appears in Completed list (2->3), counts updated in both tab labels and header summary "4 active, 3 completed".

Active tab shows only active tasks with count 4; Completed tab shows only completed tasks (Review project proposal, Reply to client emails, Organize desk) with count 3. Switching tabs correctly filters the list and each tab shows the accurate count.

"Complete tax filing" had its complete button disabled while prerequisite "Review project proposal" was incomplete. After completing the prerequisite, the complete button became enabled and clicking it successfully marked "Complete tax filing" complete (active 4->3, completed 3->4). Dependent "Submit final report" (2 prerequisites) also transitioned from disabled/blocked to enabled complete button once both prerequisites (Review project proposal, Complete tax filing) were completed.

Completed view lists all 5 completed tasks (Review project proposal, Complete tax filing, Submit final report, Reply to client emails, Organize desk) with full details intact; none were deleted by completing them, and a delete icon remains available to remove them explicitly if desired.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves completed dependent task in an invalid completed+blocked state
actual: Completed "Submit final report" (dependent on "Complete tax filing" and "Review project proposal"). Reopened prerequisite "Complete tax filing" via its reopen toggle in the Completed view. Result: "Complete tax filing" successfully returned to Active (not prevented). However "Submit final report" remained in the Completed tab (Completed count stayed 4, task still listed under Completed) while simultaneously displaying the blocked-state warning "Prerequisite \"Complete tax filing\" incomplete" and a disabled reopen/complete toggle — i.e., it is both marked completed (still in Completed view) and blocked at the same time, which violates the required behavior of either preventing the reopen or moving the dependent back to a valid incomplete/active state.

evidence: Editing "Schedule dentist appointment" (which is a prerequisite of "Buy groceries (updated)") does not offer "Buy groceries (updated)" as a selectable prerequisite option. Editing "Complete tax filing" (a prerequisite of "Submit final report") does not offer "Submit final report" as a selectable prerequisite option. Tasks whose selection would create a cycle are omitted from the prerequisite checklist.

In the Create New Task dialog, the "Create Task" button remains disabled both with an empty title and with a whitespace-only title ("   "), preventing task creation; task list count unchanged (3 active, 4 completed).

Every task card shows title (h3) and priority badge. Description and deadline render only when supplied (e.g. "Simple Task No Deadline" showed no deadline row; tasks with descriptions/deadlines show both). Blocked tasks show a distinct muted/dashed-border card style plus a "Prerequisite ... incomplete" badge and disabled complete/edit controls. Completed tasks are visually distinguished with strikethrough title (class "line-through text-muted-foreground") and muted background ("bg-muted/50"), clearly differing from active task cards ("bg-card").
